10.evidence_source: To assess the convergent validity of the BAS-2, we used Pearson correlation coefficients to assess the association between body appreciation, BMI, body pride, and body image. 2.evidence_source: The present study sought to investigate the following hypotheses. First, most previous investigations of the factor structure of the BAS-2 have found a one-factor structure.1,11 We expected, following an exploratory factor analysis (EFA), that our Arabic version would also yield a similar result. Second, participants completed additional measures of body image and body pride which enabled an analysis of the convergent validity of the BAS-2. We hypothesized, in line with previous investigations,3–5,8 that scores on the Arabic BAS-2 would be significantly and positively associated with scores on the body image and body pride measures but negatively associated with body mass index (BMI) which we ascertained through self-report of height and weight. We also report on the internal consistency of all the measures.
